title: cotula reptans var. major
intro: Cotula reptans var. major, commonly known as Greater Tansy or Common Tansy, is a perennial plant in the daisy family. It is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, indigestion, and menstrual cramps, due to its health benefits of promoting digestion, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antispasmodic. The therapeutic actions of Cotula reptans var. major include its ability to stimulate the appetite, ease coughs, and reduce anxiety, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
